Claudia Schiffer

Download PDF

Shoe 40.5

New York +
Portfolio

Supermodel and global fashion icon, Claudia Schiffer, has been elvating brands and fashion houses for over 35 years. She became a household name as the star of the iconic ‘90s Guess? Jeans campaign shot by long-term collaborator Ellen Von Unwerth and was a muse to Karl Lagerfeld, for more than 30 years. Schiffer became the first model to grace more than 1,000 magazine covers. She has walked runways for Versace, Chanel, Chloé, Yves Saint Laurent, Christian Dior, Fendi, Ralph Lauren, Louis Vuitton, and Oscar de la Renta. She’s published a series of books, including an eponymous coffee table book with Rizzoli and an art book called Captivate! Fashion Photography From the 90s, for which she curated an exhibition by the same name at Kunstpalast Düsseldorf in 2021. Schiffer has made multiple film and TV appearances, and is the co-owner of MARV, a renowned British production company. She is Executive Producer under Cloudy Productions for the blockbuster Kingsman film series and Kick-Ass, Eddie the Eagle, Rocketman, Tetris, Silent Night. and Argylle. Schiffer has been a UNICEF UK Ambassador since 1997. In 2023, she launched with Mattel a “Claudia Schiffer Barbie,” which sold out in minutes.
